facts.fact: TM Africa reports that on 10 April 2026 the President extended the NICTBB to 121 of 139 mainland districts and raised backbone capacity tenfold to 2,000 Gbps.
TM Africa says the NICTBB is expanding toward about 16,280 km in total, with an extension to the DRC in the 2026/27 work programme.

systems.owner: Government of Tanzania (transferred to government ownership 10 April 2026)

note: Ownership transfer to government stated; no access terms stated.
